content.name: Circlet of Blasting
entries: While wearing this circlet, you can use an action to cast the {@spell scorching ray} spell with it. When you make the spell's attacks, you do so with an attack bonus of {@hit 5}. The circlet can't be used this way again until the next dawn.

content.name: Circlet of Blasting
entries: While wearing this circlet, you can cast {@spell Scorching Ray|SRD52} with it ({@hit 5} to hit). The circlet can't cast this spell again until the next dawn.
